spec_basis: crates/dolly-asset/src/lib.rs::Core-owned binary Asset service (WP-010) import, identity, media, lease/GC, replica, domain contracts
crates/dolly-channel/src/lib.rs::org.dolly.channel v1 text ingress and outbound effect ledger contracts

source_boundary.handoff: committed G2 invocation context and durable Core ingress premise into the WP-010 Asset and WP-013A/013B Channel seams
source_boundary.authority: Core remains the only authority for Block, Ingress, Action, and future Asset identity; Asset and Channel services derive every trusted producer premise from a committed Core transaction and never mint authority of their own
source_boundary.effect_boundary: before Asset import, host.ingress.submit, and outbound Channel effects

classification.product_red: asserts a WP-010/013A contract that only a Host/runtime adapter seam can satisfy. The probe first drives the harness (config install, graph install, real Core transaction) AND the integrated dolly-asset/dolly-channel public surface for the seam it names, so every crate contract it exercises is proven working; only the exact absent Host/runtime adapter seam named in causal_red turns the case red
classification.pass: verified against the integrated dolly-asset/dolly-channel public surface: AssetService/ImportPipeline for WP-010 and the Channel pipeline (process_event/reconcile_inbound/dispatch_send) over the real Core transaction for WP-013A. A regression here is a product violation, so the case must stay green
classification.blocked: later WP-013B seam whose interfaces (WP-010 Asset authority and WP-013A Channel send contract) are not frozen; retained in the matrix, never executed until both freeze

cases.name: bounded_import_and_crash_recovery_require_a_core_owned_import_seam
cases.pass_basis: dolly_runtime::AssetHostRoute binds host.asset.import/host.asset.status to an activated module under the sealed current Host authority + capability grant; a real import reaches a durable AVAILABLE canonical AssetRef, crash restart resolves the record, a never-created ImportId answers the authoritative explicit absent StatusResult (nondisclosing, no AssetRef, no lifecycle masquerade), and a cross-module request is refused before any effect

cases.name: canonical_asset_identity_and_dedup_are_core_authority_only
cases.pass_basis: the dolly-asset service mints AssetId = ast_b3_ + lowercase unpadded base32 of blake3-256 over accepted bytes, deduplicates identical accepted bytes within one security domain to one AssetId and one object, rejects non-canonical encodings, and emits the exact AssetRef wire shape
cases.assertion: import identical bytes twice through AssetService; require one AssetId, one content-addressed object, and canonical/non-canonical AssetId parse behavior

cases.name: mime_sniffing_and_security_refusal_precede_availability
cases.pass_basis: the dolly-asset service sniffs declared media against actual bytes before any availability: MEDIA_TYPE_MISMATCH for active content labeled image/png, SIZE_LIMIT cut-off for over-limit sources, INVALID_BASE64 for malformed encodings with no durable record, SOURCE_DENIED for SSRF-credential URLs, and SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE for remotes with no Host transport
cases.assertion: drive AssetService refusals for a MIME spoof, an over-limit payload, bad base64, and an SSRF-shaped URL; require the exact refusal codes before availability

cases.name: leases_pins_and_gc_use_atomic_durable_retention
cases.pass_basis: the dolly-asset service issues an unguessable LeaseId with finite expiry, makes lease creation atomic against a non-tombstone check, requires privilege for expiry-less pins, blocks the sweep with a live lease/pin/durable reference, runs mark/tombstone/sweep GC, never resurrects a tombstoned asset, and a reference created after a tombstone never wins
cases.assertion: drive lease, expiry-less pin, and durable-reference retention through GC sweep; require the sweep to stop on each live retention and to tombstone only after every reference is gone

cases.name: required_replicas_never_expose_unverified_bytes
cases.pass_basis: the dolly-asset service refuses remote_required without a replica before acquisition, holds a failing replica as REPLICA_FAILED with REMOTE_REPLICA_FAILED and no exposed asset, and reaches AVAILABLE only after the replica verifies the same content hash
cases.assertion: drive remote_required across no-replica, failing-replica, and working-replica configurations; require REFUSED/REPLICA_FAILED/non-available semantics and verify-after-upload

cases.name: security_domain_isolation_is_recorded_and_enforced
cases.pass_basis: the dolly-asset service records a durable security_domain per asset row, authorizes import by the capability's module+instance+domain, and denies any read/stream/view from a domain that never imported the bytes even when a hash match exists elsewhere
cases.assertion: import identical bytes in two domains; require distinct domain-bound records, a denied cross-domain read, and Unauthorized on module/instance capability mismatch

cases.name: authenticated_text_round_trip_runs_producer_to_durable_premise_to_consumer
cases.pass_basis: the dolly_runtime channel inbound route (authenticated_channel_event + open_channel_inbound_route over the real durable host.ingress.submit slice, one runtime DB plus the module-scoped Channel store) commits an authenticated event to a durable Core premise under a Host-derived identity the caller never chooses; a byte-identical replay is idempotent and an opposite-premise conflict changes nothing

cases.name: committed_action_consumer_is_a_missing_runtime_loop
cases.seam: committed-Action outbound consumer seam (D): the runtime selects targeted org.dolly.channel.send Actions from committed Core Blocks and drives them through dispatch_send, the outbound ledger, and the transport
cases.causal_red: a committed org.dolly.channel.send Action sits durable in the real Core snapshot and the dolly_channel outbound pipeline turns it into a confirmed ActionResult, but only because the probe extracts the block and invokes parse_send_action/dispatch_send manually — the shipping runtime has no committed-Action outbound consumer loop that does that step
cases.verify: commit a send Action durably and prove the crate pipeline confirms it when invoked, then require the runtime consumer loop; absent -> PRODUCT_RED

cases.name: ingress_reconciliation_reads_status_instead_of_resubmitting
cases.pass_basis: dolly_runtime::reconcile_channel_inbound_route is status-first through the real registration path: a lost response that left a durable prepared intent is settled via host.ingress.status exactly once with zero resubmission, and a restart reconcile is a no-op that never rewrites history

cases.name: sender_conversation_session_and_capability_are_authorized_before_any_dispatch
cases.pass_basis: the dolly-channel pipeline authorizes the transport account, sender, conversation, sender class, and session BEFORE any durable mutation or Core call, and refuses a session-missing send before any dispatch; no discovery of other sessions
cases.assertion: drive process_event with a cross-owner account, an unauthorized sender, and a session-missing send; require CHANNEL_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED / CHANNEL_AUTHORIZATION_FAILED / CHANNEL_SESSION_MISSING with zero Core calls and zero transport calls

cases.name: outbound_replay_returns_the_existing_result_without_resend
cases.pass_basis: the dolly-channel outbound ledger keys by action_id: a confirmed action replay returns the existing result with a single dispatch record and never re-dispatches; unknown sends are never auto-repeated
cases.assertion: dispatch once to confirmed, replay the same committed action, and require the existing result, exactly one transport call, and one dispatch record

cases.name: unknown_and_partial_outcomes_are_explicit_and_non_retryable
cases.pass_basis: the dolly-channel outbound ledger maps a lost send response to a terminal unknown (never failed, never re-dispatched) and a partial multi-piece send to a terminal partial with result null, code CHANNEL_PARTIAL_DELIVERY, retryable false, outcome applied, and per-piece ordinals
cases.assertion: drive a Timeout send to unknown recovery and a split send to terminal partial; require the exact ActionResult envelope fields and no wholesale retry

cases.name: outbound_rate_limits_use_bounded_queues_and_caller_deadlines
cases.seam: committed-Action outbound consumer seam (D): a bounded outbound queue with caller-deadline enforcement in the dispatch path, so a burst is queued under a caller deadline and transport unavailability never blocks Core input state
cases.causal_red: the exercised dolly_channel admission path rate-limits per session with a token bucket (verified: a one-piece send is admitted and confirmed while a three-piece burst is refused as CHANNEL_RATE_LIMITED retryable with no transport call). That proves the rate bucket, not queuing: there is no bounded outbound QUEUE primitive and no caller-deadline wait/expiry in the dispatch path, so a burst is REJECTED rather than queued under a caller deadline
cases.verify: drive the token-bucket admission limit (accept then refuse a burst), then require a bounded queue with caller-deadline expiry for the refused burst; absent -> PRODUCT_RED

cases.name: credentials_paths_and_signed_urls_never_enter_metadata_or_logs
cases.pass_basis: the dolly-channel pipeline builds drafts from a fixed allowlist record: transport credentials, cookies, local paths, and signed URLs carried by a hostile event never enter the committed draft, the ledger row, or attempt history; channel metadata is namespaced and content-free
cases.assertion: ingress a hostile event carrying credential/path/signed-URL fields; require none of them in the committed draft or attempt history

cases.name: channel_cannot_append_to_a_page_or_advance_a_cursor_directly
cases.pass_basis: the dolly-channel pipeline's only durable write route is the host.ingress.submit seam backed by the real Core transaction; a committed draft reaches the Page only as a Block delivery, no Page record is fabricated, and no Module cursor is advanced by the Channel
cases.assertion: run the inbound pipeline over real Core and require the committed block plus its block delivery to the target Page, with no Page or cursor mutation commands

cases.name: asset_import_and_send_seam_binds_channel_parts_to_core_assets
cases.blocked_reason: WP-010 Asset authority (G4-WP010-* product_red) and WP-013A Channel send contract (G4-WP013A-* product_red) are not frozen; this seam must not be executed against unstable interfaces
cases.seam: org.dolly.channel.send carries Core Part AssetRefs; the Channel imports or pins through host.asset.import and never trusts action media_type
cases.causal_red: no AssetRef Part exists in the v1 channel send profile, so a Channel send cannot bind parts to committed hash-checked Assets

cases.name: mime_and_lease_round_trip_through_core_assets
cases.blocked_reason: depends on the WP-010 MIME/lease contract and the WP-013A send ActionContract; interfaces are not frozen; blocked with G4-WP013B-ASSET-SEND-SEAM-001
cases.seam: outbound Asset parts read under a short Asset lease with authoritative detected media type
cases.causal_red: no lease or detected-media-type authority exists on the channel send path today

cases.name: media_abuse_round_trip_refuses_unsafe_or_unowned_media
cases.blocked_reason: needs the WP-010 security/domain contract and WP-013A authorization; interfaces are not frozen; blocked with G4-WP013B-ASSET-SEND-SEAM-001
cases.seam: unsafe media, cross-domain AssetRefs, and forged media_type are refused before any send dispatch
cases.causal_red: no media or domain authority exists on the channel send path, so abuse cannot be refused

cases.name: producer_premise_is_durable_explicit_and_never_reversible
cases.assertion: identical ingress replay returns the prior mapping; a different digest under the same key is STORAGE_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, never an overwrite; the record survives a store reopen

cases.name: ingress_keys_are_producer_scoped_without_echo_collision
references: crates/dolly-core-reducer/tests/wp004_conformance.rs::ingress identity is scoped to the producer
cases.assertion: two producer sources using the same ingress key yield independent durable records; replaying the first source returns only its prior mapping

cases.name: action_names_are_owner_fenced_against_cross_extension_forgery
cases.assertion: org.dolly.channel.send parses only for owner org.dolly.channel; any other owner or foreign-prefixed action name is rejected

cases.name: core_transaction_catalog_has_no_third_party_page_or_cursor_mutation
references: crates/dolly-core-reducer/src/command.rs::CoreCommand catalog contains no page-append or cursor-advance variant
cases.assertion: the exhaustive CoreCommand catalog publishes external drafts only through Ingress and RuntimeEvent; no variant appends a Page or advances a Module cursor; every durable write passes the Core transaction

cases.name: block_bytes_stay_untrusted_until_a_core_asset_authority_exists
references: crates/dolly-core-reducer/src/types.rs::CoreSnapshot carries no asset, lease, pin, or replica record
crates/dolly-core-reducer/src/command.rs::CoreCommand contains no asset-import or AssetRef-minting variant
cases.assertion: an ingress draft carrying asset_input bytes is committed verbatim as untrusted Block content with no AssetId, content hash record, or availability claim; the Core transaction catalog mints no asset identity today
